title: Colin S Probable NDE 5281
content: Our house, situated in the bush three miles from town, relied for its water supply on a large concrete tank at the back of the house. No one much came to that spot. At the foot of the tank was an electric pump, which came on when the faucet in the house was turned on. One day, the tail end of a cyclone hit our area, and it knocked down some of the grid poles and we lost electric power. When the electricity was restored the next day, I walked around the house to check on the tank and noticed a dead bird floating in the water. Standing next to the pump motor, I took a rake, leaned up against the tank, and tried to pull the bird toward me. I was concentrating on what I was doing, and did not notice when my right leg touched the motor. Suddenly, with the electricity going through me, I became frozen to the tank and was unable to move. The electricity stopped my central nervous system from functioning and I was no longer able to breathe. I did realize, in a sort of hazy way, that this would be 'over and out' for me. Well, one of our endeavors was a school bus service. In my mind, as I stood in this fixed state, I was driving my bus at breakneck speed down a bush lane with trees on both sides. No matter what I did, I was unable to get my foot off the accelerator. I felt great concern for the kids riding in my bus. It was quiet; I heard no sound of any kind. The image faded and I don't know how long I stood there, or what happened next. When I came to, one of our employees was standing over me. Fortunately, three days before this event, he had read a brochure, issued by the SEC (State Electricity Commission) that explained what to do in case of an electrocution. Fortunately, he decided to check on the water tank maybe minutes after I did. He took me inside, and I sat there deep breathing for at least half an hour. Next, I was examined at the local hospital, and it took some time to find the burn mark on my calf. (This later became an open wound, and then it began to heal - new tissue grew from both ends, meeting at the middle.) It took about a year for certain simple words to come to me. I have had no further ill effects from the experience. Since my experience, I have developed deeper insights as to who and what 'God' is. I have served, for many years, until recently, as a counselor to terminally ill people. Death is no concern to me, knowing that it will be beautiful. It does concern me that I may cause grief to family and friends. I'm also thankful for the experience, as it has enriched my life greatly. Your work is equally interesting. I wish you well.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Electrocution while standing near an electric pump motor at a water tank after power was restored.

person_demographics.occupation: School bus service (bus driver/operator); later counselor to terminally ill people.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: While immobilized during electrocution and unable to breathe, experienced a vivid mental scene of driving a school bus at breakneck speed, unable to lift foot from the accelerator; then the image faded and later regained consciousness with an employee standing over him.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Instead of classic NDE features (OBE/tunnel/light/beings), the experience was a silent, vivid scenario of uncontrollable high-speed bus driving with concern for children, occurring during electrocution-induced paralysis and apnea.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “over and out” ; “Death is no concern to me, knowing that it will be beautiful.”
